messages:
nina: publish pipeline flaked on typegen regendiff. only change is changelog metadata (timestamp + generator meta). anyone seen this pattern?

ci-bot: [automated] publish job failed: typegen-regendiff. logs: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/2766000000/logs (regendiff.tar.gz)

rob: yep. caused us grief last week. usually a non-deterministic header in CHANGELOG.md from the generator.

andrew: quick check: running the regen with GIT_AUTHOR_DATE/GIT_COMMITTER_DATE fixed produces identical output. so metadata is the culprit.

tia: Two mitigations: (A) pin the typegen binary in the publish workflow until we roll a canonicalizer, (B) update regendiff to filter out header-only diffs. prefer A for now to get the release unblocked.

nina: agree. i'll open a tiny workflow change to pin 1.4.2 and add a comment referencing an issue for canonicalization.

rob: also add a unit test in the typegen repo that runs regen with a frozen env and asserts no diffs. that will catch future format tweaks.

andrew: filing issue #498: "deterministic typegen outputs & changelog canonicalizer" - adding acceptance criteria and a sample patch for normalization.

tia: PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/879 (pins typegen and adds note). once merged rerun publish.

ci-bot: CI re-run requested by nina.

nina: thanks all. scheduling the canonicalizer work for next sprint and linking tests here. low-risk hotfix for publish first.
